meta.title: The $250 gap
meta.prompt: A group of friends has agreed on a trip budget of $1,500. However, one member has unexpectedly reduced their maximum contribution from $400 to $150, while the remaining members are unwilling to increase their contributions. Can you help the group renegotiate the budget, explore feasible alternatives, and reach an agreement that respects everyone's financial constraints?
meta.context: Four friends (Ana, Ben, Cara, Dev) planned a lake weekend. Original pledges: Ana $400, Ben $400, Cara $400, Dev $300 (total $1,500). Ana now says she can give only $150. The others will not raise their pledges, so $1,250 is available. The original plan was the top option in every category.

events.text: Solver on the public information only.
